refreshes_liveness: new tool or compute result that materially advances the objective
resume-capable checkpoint with a concrete next action
does_not_refresh_liveness: unverified claim that another conversation is still working

durable_frontier_contract.definition: The newest externally verifiable state sufficient for another conversation to resume without trusting stale chat claims.
preferred_sources: pull request state and changed files
persisted checker/build/test result with its source ref
forbidden_as_sole_source: statement that work is happening elsewhere
durable_frontier_contract.checkpoint_rule: Do not carry more than one meaningful semantic phase exclusively in conversation-local state. Persist a resume-capable checkpoint at phase boundaries and before relinquishing a task.

protocol: Detect that the predecessor conversation has produced no new verifiable action for the stale threshold.
Do not wait for or interrogate the predecessor conversation as an execution authority.
Rebuild the durable frontier from repository and control-plane evidence.
Classify the predecessor as VERIFIED_COMPLETE, IN_PROGRESS_RECOVERABLE, UNFINISHED, or NEVER_STARTED.
If VERIFIED_COMPLETE, consume the durable result and do not repeat the work.

If IN_PROGRESS_RECOVERABLE, persist a takeover/recovery ref, use Driver or SYSTEM ORPHAN authority when a live Scheduler claim must be released, then ADOPT or otherwise resume from the same durable frontier.
If UNFINISHED, preserve valid evidence, explicitly orphan/requeue the incomplete execution, and restart only the missing portion.
If NEVER_STARTED, release the stale assignment and dispatch normally.
Continue the parent objective in the recovering conversation; never ask the user to keep another conversation alive.

scheduler_bridge.live_claim_preemption: A Driver or SYSTEM may emit ORPHAN with reason=STALE_CONVERSATION_NO_VERIFIABLE_ACTION_10M and an evidence/recovery ref even when the ordinary task claim lease has not expired.
scheduler_bridge.recovery: ADOPT requires a fresh execution identity/claim plus recovery_ref pointing to the reconstructed durable frontier.
scheduler_bridge.ordinary_claim_lease: The long task claim lease protects ownership against accidental duplicate dispatch; it must not be interpreted as permission to wait on a stale chat for its full duration.

start_and_checkpoint_rule.before_substantive_work: Resolve task/identity and create the earliest supported durable execution stamp or accepted runtime claim before entering a long research phase.
start_and_checkpoint_rule.after_material_phase: Persist changed knowledge/control facts and a concrete next action when the phase has produced reusable evidence.
start_and_checkpoint_rule.progress_update: User-facing progress is observability only; if a durable checkpoint is available, persist it before the update rather than leaving the only frontier in prose.
